source.title: Frontier Sentinel, 30 April 1914, p. 3 ("Crossmaglen Rural District": nominations lodged 27 April with W. H. Starr, deputy returning officer)
source.publisher: Frontier Sentinel (via the British Newspaper Archive)
source.check: every name read from the page image; returned unopposed, no poll

note: Triennial election of the rural district council (nine divisions, two councillors each), polled 28 May 1914: contests in Cloghoge, Lower Creggan, Dorsey and Moybane. Lisleitrim is not filed: three were nominated (Peter John Bellew, James Caraher, Edward Sheridan) and there was no poll, but the withdrawal was not found. No party labels are printed. Returned unopposed.
